CWE-22.name: Path Traversal

CWE-78.name: OS Command Injection
CWE-78.description: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an operating system command.

CWE-89.name: SQL Injection
CWE-89.description: Improper neutralization of special elements used in an SQL command.

CWE-95.name: Eval Injection
CWE-95.description: Improper neutralization of directives in dynamically evaluated code.

CWE-120.name: Buffer Copy without Checking Size of Input
CWE-120.description: Copying a buffer without verifying that the input fits into the destination.

CWE-134.name: Use of Externally-Controlled Format String

CWE-502.name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
CWE-502.description: Deserializing untrusted data without ensuring that the resulting data is safe.

CWE-787.name: Out-of-bounds Write
CWE-787.description: Writing data outside the bounds of an allocated memory buffer.
